messages:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: SYNTH_HEARTBEAT_FAIL - eu-west-1 - 18/24 synthetic probes failing (mix of 502 & connection timeout). escalation policy: oncall-sre -> secondline. link: https://pd.example/INC12345
PagerDuty: Incident INC12345 created and assigned to Ryan Chen (on-call). Priority: P1. Notes: probes started failing ~2024-10-02T03:20Z.
Ryan Chen: acked. I'm on call and starting triage. which probes exactly are failing?
SRE Shift Bot: probe breakdown: heartbeat-prober-eu-west: 24 total targets, 18 failed (12x 502, 6x tcp timeout). Avg latency spike from 120ms -> 2.4s in last 3m.
Priya Patel: seeing same on dashboards. Traffic to runtime endpoints in eu-west shows a 5xx spike around 03:18-03:22. No customer-reported incidents yet.
Alex Morgan: quick check — no EU deploys in the window per deploy-service. I ran `git log` for prod branch; last deploy ~2024-10-01 22:10Z.
Ryan Chen: good. I'll check the edge gateway and prober instances. Pulling logs now.
Ryan Chen: `kubectl -n infra logs deploy/gateway-eu --since=10m | grep "502" | tail -n 20`
Ryan Chen: logs show repeated upstream 502 from host runtime-eu-01.internal, traces indicate `upstream response timeout` and `502` returned by our nginx proxy.
Priya Patel: can you test hitting runtime-eu-01 directly? I'll try a curl from a jumpbox.
Priya Patel: (from jumpbox) `curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\n" https://runtime-eu-01.internal/health` -> `502 1.98`
Alex Morgan: checking network/firewall — I see a transient increase in dropped packets in the cloud provider's SG logs starting ~03:15, correlated with a routing flapping event on one fabric link. Could be partial networking outage to a subset of hosts.
Ryan Chen: that aligns. If upstream is flaky, probes will 502 or timeout. For mitigation: 1) fail probes over to alternate region? 2) mark runtime-eu-01 as degraded so LB stops sending traffic. Thoughts?
Priya Patel: immediate: remove runtime-eu-01 from the loadbalancer target group, and scale up runtime-eu-02/03 to absorb traffic. I'll run the remove and scale commands.
Priya Patel: `aws elbv2 deregister-targets --target-group-arn arn:tg:eu-west:... --targets Id=i-0abcdef12345`
SRE Shift Bot: action recorded: target i-0abcdef12345 removed from tg-rt-eu-west at 2024-10-02T03:28:12Z by Priya Patel.
Ryan Chen: nice. After removing, can we kick a manual probe run?
SRE Shift Bot: manual probe queued: run-id r-202410020328. Results in ~45s...
SRE Shift Bot: manual probe results: 24/24 OK (after removal & scale).
Priya Patel: good — that looks like it fixed probe failures. I'll keep target removed and open a ticket to replace the host.
Alex Morgan: I'll open a cloud provider case about the fabric route flaps; adding logs and timestamps. Might be transient infra.
Ryan Chen: summary for PD: SYNTH_HEARTBEAT_FAIL triggered due to partial network fabric flapping causing upstream 502/timeouts from runtime-eu-01. Mitigation: removed unhealthy target from LB, scaled remaining instances, manual probe shows green. No customer-facing errors reported in metrics or support.
Priya Patel: I'm going to keep monitoring for 30m and then hand off to next on-call. If fabric flaps recur, we'll consider a rollback of any recent infra config or moving traffic regionally.
Ryan Chen: adding runbook notes and closing PD alert once we confirm stability. Also tagging this thread `postmortem-candidate` to decide if followup needed.
PagerDuty: INC12345 status changed to acknowledged by Ryan Chen.
Ryan Chen: handing off to Priya Patel for ongoing watch. Handoff notes: removed bad host i-0abcdef12345, scale to 4 instances in eu-west, cloud provider case opened (CP-7892). If you see >3 probe failures again, escalate to secondline and consider region failover.
Priya Patel: acked. I'll handle the wake window. Leaving runbook link: https://runbooks.internal/synth-probe-triage.
SRE Shift Bot: reminder set: check probe health in 10m and 30m.
Priya Patel: thanks all. Closing noise for now; will ping this channel with updates. :white_check_mark:
